members.example: She made a beautiful cake for her mother.(她为妈妈做了一个漂亮的蛋糕。)

members.gloss: v.创造; 创建; 产生.
members.example: The artist created a beautiful painting.(这位艺术家创作了一幅美丽的画。)

members.gloss: v.生产；制造；产生. n.农产品.
members.example: This factory produces cars.(这家工厂生产汽车。)
Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.(托马斯·爱迪生发明了电灯泡。)
The telephone is one of the greatest inventions in history.(电话是历史上最伟大的发明之一。)
The discovery of fire changed human history.(火的发现改变了人类历史。)

members.gloss: n.先驱；开拓者. v.开辟；倡导.
members.example: He was a pioneer in the field of computer science.(他是计算机科学领域的先驱。)

analysis.pos_difference: make：v.（动词）；create：v.（动词）；produce：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；invent：v.（动词）；invention：n.（名词）；discovery：n.（名词）；pioneer：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: make 最通用，指制造、做；create 强调从无到有的创造；produce 侧重生产、制造（尤指批量或自然产生）；invent 指发明前所未有的东西，invention 是其名词；discovery 指发现已存在的事物；pioneer 指开拓新领域的先驱。
analysis.collocation: make sth.；create/produce sth.；invent a machine；make a discovery；a pioneer in/of
analysis.summary: 泛指制作用 make；文学艺术创作用 create；生产用 produce；发明用 invent；发现用 discovery。

members.example: Do you know the answer to this question?(你知道这个问题的答案吗？)
We should learn from each other.(我们应该互相学习。)
I don't understand what you mean.(我不明白你的意思。)
I didn't realize it was so late.(我没意识到已经这么晚了。)
I didn't recognize her because she had changed a lot.(我没认出她，因为她变化很大。)
Reading is the best way to gain knowledge.(阅读是获取知识的最好方式。)

analysis.pos_difference: know：v.（动词）；learn：v.（动词）；understand：v.（动词）；realize：v.（动词）；recognize：v.（动词）；knowledge：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: know 指知道、认识的状态；learn 指通过学习获得；understand 强调理解含义或道理；realize 指突然意识到；recognize 指认出、辨认出曾见过的人或物；knowledge 是名词，指知识。
analysis.collocation: know/learn about；understand the meaning；realize that…；recognize sb.'s voice；knowledge of
analysis.summary: 知道用 know；学会用 learn；理解用 understand；意识到用 realize；认出用 recognize。

members.gloss: v.需要. n.需要; 需求.
members.example: We need to buy some food for the party.(我们需要为聚会买一些食物。)
This job requires a lot of patience.(这份工作需要很大的耐心。)

members.gloss: v.请求；要求. n.请求；要求.
members.example: He made a request to leave school early today.(他请求今天早点离校。)

analysis.usage_difference: need 最通用，指需要；require 较正式，指（规则、条件）要求、需要；request 指礼貌地请求，语气客气。
analysis.collocation: need to do / need doing；require sb. to do；request sth. from sb.
analysis.summary: 日常需要用 need；正式规定要求用 require；客气请求用 request。

members.gloss: v.玩; 演奏. n.游戏; 戏剧.
members.example: The children are playing in the park.(孩子们正在公园里玩耍。)

members.gloss: v.展示; 给…看. n.表演; 节目.
members.example: Can you show me how to use this computer?(你能给我演示一下怎么用这台电脑吗？)

members.gloss: v.行动；表演；起作用. n.行为；法令.
members.example: We must act now to protect the environment.(我们必须现在就行动起来保护环境。)

members.gloss: v.表演; 执行; 表现.
members.example: The students performed a play at the school festival.(学生们在学校文化节上表演了一出话剧。)

analysis.pos_difference: play：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；show：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；act：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；perform：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: play 指玩耍、打球、演奏乐器；show 指展示、演出（也可作名词）；act 指行动或在戏剧中扮演角色；perform 指正式表演、演出，也可指执行、表现。
analysis.collocation: play basketball/the piano；on show；act as；perform on stage
analysis.summary: 玩耍打球用 play；给人看用 show；扮演角色用 act；登台演出用 perform。

members.gloss: adv.正好; 仅仅; 刚才.
members.example: I just finished reading that book yesterday.(我昨天刚读完那本书。)

members.gloss: adv.简单地; 仅仅; 只不过.
members.example: I simply don't understand why he left.(我完全不明白他为什么离开了。)

analysis.usage_difference: just 表示正好、仅仅、刚才；simply 表示仅仅、只不过，还可表示简单地。
analysis.collocation: just now；just right；simply because
analysis.summary: 刚才、恰好用 just；只不过用 simply。

members.example: People from different countries have different cultures.(来自不同国家的人有不同的文化。)
Can you tell the difference between the two pictures?(你能看出这两幅画的区别吗？)
Tom and I are in the same class.(汤姆和我在同一个班。)
Your bag is similar to mine.(你的包和我的很相似。)

members.gloss: adj.相反的; 对面的. n.对立面. prep.在…对面.
members.example: The bank is opposite the supermarket.(银行在超市对面。)
If you compare the two pictures, you will find five differences.(如果你比较这两幅图片，你会发现五处不同。)

analysis.pos_difference: different：adj.（形容词）；difference：n.（名词）；same：adj.（形容词）；similar：adj.（形容词）；opposite：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）、prep.（介词）；compare：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: different 指不同的；difference 是其名词；same 指相同的，常与 the 连用；similar 指相似但不完全相同；opposite 指相反的、对面的；compare 指通过比较找出异同。
analysis.collocation: be different from；the same as；be similar to；the opposite of；compare A with/to B
analysis.summary: 不同用 different(from)；相同用 the same(as)；相似用 similar(to)；对比用 compare。

members.gloss: v.保持; 继续; 保存.
members.example: Please keep quiet in the library.(请在图书馆保持安静。)

members.gloss: v.停留; 保持. n.逗留.
members.example: He stayed at home and took care of his little sister.(他待在家照顾妹妹。)

members.gloss: v.保持; 留下; 剩余.
members.example: Please remain in your seats until the bus stops.(请留在座位上直到公交车停下。)
Please continue reading from page ten.(请从第十页继续读下去。)

analysis.usage_difference: keep 指保持某种状态或继续做；stay 指停留、保持（某种状态不变）；remain 较正式，指仍然是、留下；continue 指中断后或不中断地继续。
analysis.collocation: keep doing；keep + adj.；stay healthy；remain silent；continue doing/to do
analysis.summary: 保持状态用 keep/stay；书面语“仍然是”用 remain；继续做用 keep/continue doing。

members.gloss: v.开始; 出发. n.开始; 起点.
members.example: The meeting will start at nine o'clock.(会议将在九点开始。)
The school year begins in September.(学年在九月份开始。)

members.gloss: v.完成; 结束. n.结束.
members.example: Have you finished your homework yet?(你做完作业了吗？)

members.gloss: v.完成. adj.完整的；彻底的.
members.example: Please complete the form before you leave.(请在离开前填完这张表。)

analysis.pos_difference: start：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；begin：v.（动词）；finish：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；complete：v.（动词）、adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: start 与 begin 几乎通用，start 还可指启动、出发；finish 指做完某事；complete 较正式，强调完整地完成，也可作形容词“完整的”。
analysis.collocation: start/begin doing/to do；finish doing；complete sth.
analysis.summary: 开始用 start/begin；做完用 finish(doing)；圆满完成用 complete。

members.example: China is a great country with a long history.(中国是一个有着悠久历史的伟大国家。)
We had a wonderful time at the party.(我们在聚会上玩得非常开心。)
You did an excellent job on the exam.(你考试考得非常棒。)
Nobody is perfect in this world.(这个世界上没有人是完美的。)

members.gloss: adj.好的；健康的；晴朗的. n.罚款. v.罚款.
members.example: The weather is fine today — let's go outside.(今天天气很好——我们出去吧。)

analysis.pos_difference: great：adj.（形容词）；wonderful：adj.（形容词）；excellent：adj.（形容词）；perfect：adj.（形容词）；fine：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: great 泛指伟大的、极好的；wonderful 指令人惊喜的、精彩的；excellent 指优秀的、杰出的，常用于正式评价；perfect 指完美无缺的；fine 指好的、健康的、晴朗的（How are you? —Fine.）。
analysis.collocation: a great success；a wonderful trip；an excellent student；a perfect day
analysis.summary: 口语叫好说 great/wonderful；正式称赞优秀用 excellent；毫无缺点用 perfect。

members.gloss: adj.小的; 少的. adv.少许.
members.example: The little girl is singing a beautiful song.(那个小女孩正在唱一首优美的歌。)
The tiny ant carried a piece of food on its back.(那只小蚂蚁背上驮着一块食物。)
There is a huge tree in front of our school.(我们学校前面有一棵巨大的树。)

analysis.usage_difference: little 指小的、少的；tiny 比 little 更小，指极小的；huge 指巨大的。
analysis.collocation: a little boy；a tiny insect；a huge building
analysis.summary: 小用 little；极小到微小用 tiny；巨大用 huge。

members.gloss: adj.对的; 右边的. adv.正确地. n.权利; 右边.
members.example: You are right. The answer is B.(你是对的。答案是B。)

members.gloss: adj.正确的. v.纠正; 改正.
members.example: All your answers are correct.(你所有的答案都是正确的。)

members.gloss: adj.真的; 真实的; 正确的.
members.example: Is it true that he won the first prize?(他得了一等奖是真的吗？)
Please tell me the truth.(请告诉我真相。)
Do you know the exact time of the meeting?(你知道会议的确切时间吗？)

members.gloss: adj.合适的; 恰当的; 正确的.
members.example: You need to use proper language in a formal letter.(在正式信件中你需要使用恰当的语言。)

members.gloss: n.错误; 过失. v.弄错; 误解.
members.example: Everyone makes mistakes sometimes.(每个人有时候都会犯错。)

analysis.pos_difference: right：adj.（形容词）、adv.（副词）、n.（名词）；correct：adj.（形容词）、v.（动词）；true：adj.（形容词）；truth：n.（名词）；exact：adj.（形容词）；proper：adj.（形容词）；mistake：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: right 最通用，指对的、正确的；correct 较正式，指答案、做法正确，作动词指纠正；proper 指恰当的、合适的；true 指真实的、符合事实的；truth 是名词“真相”；exact 指精确的、丝毫不差的；mistake 指错误，是这组词的反义对照。
analysis.collocation: a right/correct answer；a true story；tell the truth；the exact time；make a mistake
analysis.summary: 对错用 right/correct；真假用 true/truth；精确用 exact；错误用 mistake。

members.example: She wants to become a doctor when she grows up.(她长大后想成为一名医生。)

members.gloss: v.生长; 种植; 变得.
members.example: Rice grows well in the south of China.(水稻在中国南方长得很好。)

members.gloss: v.转动; 转向; 变成. n.轮流.
members.example: Turn left and you will see the hospital.(向左转，你就会看到医院。)

analysis.usage_difference: become 最通用，后接名词或形容词；grow 强调逐渐变化；turn 常指颜色、性质的改变，后多接形容词。
analysis.collocation: become a doctor；grow taller；turn yellow/green
analysis.summary: 成为用 become；渐渐变用 grow；颜色、性质转变用 turn。

members.example: It is important to protect the environment.(保护环境很重要。)
It is necessary for us to learn English well.(对我们来说学好英语是必要的。)

analysis.usage_difference: important 指重要的、有重大意义的；necessary 指必要的、不可缺少的。
analysis.collocation: It is important/necessary (for sb.) to do sth.
analysis.summary: 意义重大用 important；必不可少用 necessary。

members.gloss: v.拜访; 参观. n.访问.
members.example: We plan to visit the museum this weekend.(我们计划这个周末参观博物馆。)
The museum welcomes thousands of visitors every year.(这座博物馆每年接待数千名游客。)
We went sightseeing in Beijing during the holiday.(假期里我们去北京观光了。)

analysis.usage_difference: visit 指参观、拜访（人或地方）；visitor 指游客、来访者；sightseeing 是名词，专指观光、游览。
analysis.collocation: visit a museum；a foreign visitor；go sightseeing
analysis.summary: 参观某地用 visit；游客用 visitor；观光活动用 sightseeing。

members.example: Don't worry. We can solve this problem together.(别担心。我们可以一起解决这个问题。)

members.gloss: n.麻烦; 困难. v.麻烦; 使烦恼.
members.example: I'm sorry to trouble you, but can you help me?(抱歉打扰你，你能帮我一下吗？)

members.gloss: n.事情；问题. v.要紧；有关系.
members.example: It doesn't matter if you make mistakes — just keep trying.(犯错没关系——继续努力就好。)
Please don't disturb me while I'm studying.(我学习的时候请不要打扰我。)

analysis.pos_difference: problem：n.（名词）；trouble：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；matter：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；disturb：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: problem 指需要解决的难题；trouble 指麻烦、困境，常不可数；matter 指事情、问题，常用于“怎么了”；disturb 是动词，指打扰、使不安。
analysis.collocation: solve a problem；in trouble；What's the matter?；disturb sb.
analysis.summary: 难题用 problem；麻烦用 trouble；“怎么回事”用 matter；打扰别人用 disturb。

members.example: China is one of the largest countries in the world.(中国是世界上最大的国家之一。)
China is a great nation with a long history.(中国是一个有着悠久历史的伟大国家。)

members.gloss: adj.国家的；民族的；全国性的.
members.example: October 1st is China's National Day.(十月一日是中国的国庆节。)
English is an important international language.(英语是一门重要的国际语言。)

analysis.usage_difference: country 最常用，指国家（也可指乡村）；nation 较正式，侧重民族、国民；national 是形容词“国家的、民族的”；international 指国际的。
analysis.collocation: a developing country；the whole nation；national flag；international trade
analysis.summary: 日常说国家用 country；正式文体用 nation；国际的用 international。

members.gloss: v.停止; 阻止. n.车站; 停止.
members.example: The bus stopped at the school gate.(公共汽车停在了学校门口。)

members.gloss: v.预防; 防止; 阻止.
members.example: We should take action to prevent pollution.(我们应该采取行动来防止污染。)
You should avoid eating too much junk food.(你应该避免吃太多垃圾食品。)

analysis.usage_difference: stop 指使停止或停止做；prevent 指阻止某事发生；avoid 指主动避开、避免。
analysis.collocation: stop doing / stop to do；prevent sb. (from) doing；avoid doing
analysis.summary: 停下用 stop；阻止发生用 prevent(from)；主动避开用 avoid(doing)。

members.gloss: v.改变; 变化. n.变化; 零钱.
members.example: The weather changes a lot in spring.(春天的天气变化很大。)

members.gloss: v.交换; 兑换. n.交换; 交流.
members.example: The two schools exchange students every year.(两所学校每年交换学生。)

analysis.usage_difference: change 指改变、变化（也可作名词“零钱”）；exchange 指互换、交换或兑换货币。
analysis.collocation: change one's mind；change into；exchange A for B；exchange gifts
analysis.summary: 变化用 change；互相交换用 exchange。

members.gloss: n.种类. adj.善良的; 和蔼的.
members.example: She is a kind girl and always helps others.(她是个善良的女孩，总是帮助别人。)

members.gloss: n.种类；类型. v.分类；整理.
members.example: What sort of music do you like best?(你最喜欢哪种音乐？)

analysis.usage_difference: kind 指种类，也可作形容词“善良的”；sort 与 kind 同义，口语中更常用，也可作动词“分类”。
analysis.collocation: a kind/sort of；all kinds of；what kind of
analysis.summary: 种类用 kind/sort；“善良”义只用 kind。

members.example: I'm glad to hear that you passed the exam.(听说你考试通过了，我很高兴。)
Listen carefully and answer my questions.(仔细听，然后回答我的问题。)
That sounds like a great idea!(那听起来是个好主意！)

analysis.usage_difference: hear 强调听到的结果；listen 强调听的动作，后接 to；sound 作系动词表示听起来。
analysis.collocation: hear sb. do/doing；listen to music；sound great
analysis.summary: 听见用 hear；去听听用 listen(to)；听起来用 sound。

members.example: The young man is a very good teacher.(那个年轻人是一位非常好的老师。)
Many teenagers enjoy listening to pop music.(很多青少年喜欢听流行音乐。)

members.gloss: adj.年少的; 初级的. n.晚辈.
members.example: He is a junior high school student.(他是一名初中生。)

members.gloss: adj.年长的；高年级的.n.年长者.
members.example: She is a senior student in high school.(她是一名高中高年级学生。)

members.gloss: adj.首要的; 初级的; 小学的.
members.example: I went to a primary school near my home.(我上的是家附近的一所小学。)

analysis.pos_difference: young：adj.（形容词）；teenager：n.（名词）；junior：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）；senior：adj.（形容词）；primary：adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: young 指年轻的；teenager 指 13 至 19 岁的青少年；junior 指年少的、初级的；senior 指年长的、高年级的；primary 指初级的、小学的（primary school 小学）。
analysis.collocation: a young man；junior high school；senior high school；primary school
analysis.summary: 年轻用 young；青少年用 teenager；初中用 junior high；高中用 senior high；小学用 primary。

members.example: You should finish your homework before dinner.(你应该在晚饭前完成作业。)
You must hand in your homework on time.(你必须按时交作业。)

analysis.usage_difference: should 指应该，表建议或责任，语气较弱；must 指必须，语气强，还可表肯定推测“一定”。
analysis.collocation: should do；must do；must be（一定是）
analysis.summary: 劝告用 should；强制或肯定推测用 must。

members.example: I stayed at home because it was raining hard.(我待在家里，因为雨下得很大。)

members.gloss: conj.自从; 因为. prep.自…以来.
members.example: I have lived here since I was born.(我从出生起就住在这里。)

members.gloss: conj.当…的时候; 虽然. n.一会儿.
members.example: She listened to music while doing her homework.(她一边做作业一边听音乐。)

analysis.usage_difference: because 直接表原因，语气最强；since 表已知的原因“既然”，也可指“自从”；while 引导时间“当…时”，也可表对比“然而”。
analysis.collocation: because of + n.；since then；while doing
analysis.summary: 表原因首选 because；既用 since；正当…时用 while。

members.example: I enjoy reading books in my free time.(我喜欢在空闲时间读书。)
I prefer tea to coffee.(比起咖啡，我更喜欢茶。)

members.gloss: adj.最喜爱的. n.最喜爱的人或物.
members.example: What is your favorite subject?(你最喜欢的科目是什么？)

members.gloss: n.兴趣; 利息. v.使感兴趣.
members.example: He has a great interest in Chinese history.(他对中国历史有很大的兴趣。)
The beautiful flowers attracted many bees.(美丽的花朵吸引了许多蜜蜂。)

analysis.pos_difference: enjoy：v.（动词）；prefer：v.（动词）；favorite：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）；interest：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；attract：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: enjoy 指享受、喜欢做某事；prefer 指两者中更喜欢；favorite 指最喜爱的（人或物）；interest 指兴趣，或作动词“使感兴趣”；attract 指吸引。
analysis.collocation: enjoy doing；prefer A to B / prefer to do；one's favorite；be interested in；attract visitors
analysis.summary: 喜欢做用 enjoy(doing)；更偏爱用 prefer；最喜欢的人或物用 favorite。

members.gloss: v.移动; 搬家; 感动.
members.example: His family moved to a new city last year.(他的家人去年搬到了一个新城市。)

members.gloss: v.携带; 搬运; 承载.
members.example: Can you help me carry these boxes?(你能帮我搬这些箱子吗？)
Remember to bring an umbrella with you.(记得带上一把雨伞。)

analysis.usage_difference: move 指移动、搬家，也可指感动；carry 指随身携带、搬运（无方向性）；bring 指从别处带来（朝向说话人）。
analysis.collocation: move to；carry a bag；bring sth. to sb.
analysis.summary: 移动搬家用 move；扛带用 carry；带来用 bring。

members.gloss: adj.肯定的; 确信的. adv.当然.
members.example: I'm sure we will win the game.(我确信我们会赢得比赛。)
I'm certain that he will come to the meeting.(我确定他会来参加会议。)
Is it possible to finish this today?(今天完成这个有可能吗？)
It is likely to rain this afternoon.(今天下午很可能下雨。)
It will probably rain this afternoon.(今天下午可能会下雨。)
Maybe we can go to the park this weekend.(也许这个周末我们可以去公园。)
Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.(也许明天会下雨。)

analysis.pos_difference: sure：adj.（形容词）、adv.（副词）；certain：adj.（形容词）；possible：adj.（形容词）；likely：adj.（形容词）、adv.（副词）；probably：adv.（副词）；maybe：adv.（副词）；perhaps：adv.（副词）。
analysis.usage_difference: sure 指确信的，口语常用；certain 与 sure 同义，更正式，也可指“某些”；possible 指客观上可能的；likely 指很可能的（主语可是人或事）；probably、maybe、perhaps 都是副词“可能”，probably 可能性最大，maybe 多用于句首。
analysis.collocation: be sure/certain (that)/to do；It is possible that…；be likely to do；probably/maybe/perhaps + 句子
analysis.summary: 确信用 sure/certain；可能的事用 possible/likely；可能地用 probably，句首用 maybe。

members.example: Can you speak English?(你会说英语吗？)
Don't shout at me — I can hear you clearly.(不要对我大喊——我听得很清楚。)

members.gloss: v.聊天; 闲谈. n.聊天.
members.example: We often chat with friends online after school.(放学后我们经常在网上和朋友聊天。)
I had a long conversation with my best friend yesterday.(昨天我和我最好的朋友长谈了一次。)
We need to discuss this problem with our teacher.(我们需要和老师讨论这个问题。)
They often argue about what TV show to watch.(他们经常为看什么电视节目争论。)
Can you explain this math problem to me?(你能给我解释一下这道数学题吗？)
Can you describe what the man looked like?(你能描述一下那个人长什么样吗？)

analysis.pos_difference: speak：v.（动词）；shout：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；chat：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；conversation：n.（名词）；discuss：v.（动词）；argue：v.（动词）；explain：v.（动词）；describe：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: speak 指说（语言）、发言；shout 指大喊；chat 指闲聊；conversation 是名词“谈话”；discuss 指正式讨论；argue 指争论、争吵；explain 指解释原因道理；describe 指描述情形细节。
analysis.collocation: speak English；shout at/to；chat with；have a conversation；discuss sth. with sb.；argue with；explain sth. to sb.；describe sth.
analysis.summary: 讲话用 speak；大喊用 shout；闲聊用 chat；讨论用 discuss；争吵用 argue；解释用 explain；描述用 describe。

members.gloss: v.付款; 付出. n.工资.
members.example: You should pay attention to your health.(你应该注意你的健康。)
He spends two hours doing homework every day.(他每天花两个小时做作业。)
How much does this shirt cost?(这件衬衫多少钱？)
I can't afford to buy such an expensive phone.(我买不起这么贵的手机。)

analysis.pos_difference: pay：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；spend：v.（动词）；cost：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；afford：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: pay 主语是人，指付款（pay for）；spend 主语是人，指花时间或金钱（spend on/doing）；cost 主语是物，指某物值多少钱；afford 指负担得起，常与 can 连用。
analysis.collocation: pay for；spend…on/(in) doing；sth. costs sb.…；can/can't afford (to do)
analysis.summary: 人付款用 pay；人花时间金钱用 spend；物花多少钱用 cost；买得起用 afford。

members.example: Please remember to bring your book tomorrow.(请记得明天带上你的书。)
Don't forget to bring your homework.(别忘了带作业。)
I have a good memory of my childhood.(我对童年有美好的回忆。)

analysis.usage_difference: remember 指记得（remember doing 记得做过，remember to do 记得要做）；forget 是其反义；memory 是名词，指记忆力、回忆。
analysis.collocation: remember/forget to do / doing；in memory of
analysis.summary: 记得要做用 remember to do；记得做过用 remember doing；反义用 forget。

members.gloss: n.植物; 工厂. v.种植.
members.example: We planted many trees on the hill last spring.(去年春天我们在山上种了很多树。)
In autumn, leaves turn yellow and fall from the trees.(秋天，树叶变黄并从树上落下。)
Eating more vegetables is good for your health.(多吃蔬菜对你的健康有好处。)

analysis.usage_difference: plant 作名词指植物，作动词指种植；leaf 指树叶，复数 leaves；vegetable 指蔬菜。
analysis.collocation: plant trees；green leaves；fresh vegetables
analysis.summary: 种植用 plant；叶子用 leaf（复数 leaves）；蔬菜用 vegetable。

members.gloss: adj.硬的; 困难的. adv.努力地.
members.example: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.(如果你努力学习，你会通过考试的。)
This math problem is too difficult for me.(这道数学题对我来说太难了。)

analysis.usage_difference: hard 指困难的，也可指硬的、努力地；difficult 只指困难的，稍正式，不与“努力”义混淆。
analysis.collocation: a hard/difficult problem；work hard；It is difficult for sb. to do
analysis.summary: 困难用 hard/difficult；“努力地”只能是 hard（hardly 意为“几乎不”）。

members.example: I usually get up at six in the morning.(我通常早上六点起床。)
Colds are very common in winter.(感冒在冬天非常常见。)
It was just an ordinary day, nothing special happened.(那只是普通的一天，没有什么特别的事发生。)
It is normal to feel nervous before an exam.(考试前感到紧张是正常的。)

members.gloss: adj.规则的；有规律的；正规的.
members.example: Taking regular exercise is good for your health.(有规律地锻炼对你的健康有好处。)
The school has high standards for its students.(这所学校对学生有很高的标准。)
Hot pot is a typical Chinese food in winter.(火锅是中国冬天的一道典型美食。)

analysis.pos_difference: usually：adv.（副词）；common：adj.（形容词）；ordinary：adj.（形容词）；normal：adj.（形容词）；regular：adj.（形容词）；standard：n.（名词）；typical：adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: usually 是副词“通常”；common 指常见的、普遍的；ordinary 指普通的、平凡的；normal 指正常的；regular 指有规律的、定期的；standard 指标准的；typical 指典型的、有代表性的。
analysis.collocation: as usual；common sense；an ordinary day；normal temperature；regular exercise；standard English；a typical example
analysis.summary: 频率“通常”用 usually；常见用 common；平凡用 ordinary；正常用 normal；规律用 regular；标准用 standard；典型用 typical。

members.gloss: v.拿; 握; 举行. n.控制.
members.example: The Olympic Games are held every four years.(奥运会每四年举行一次。)

members.gloss: v.捕获; 抓住; 赶上.
members.example: He ran fast to catch the bus.(他跑得很快去赶公共汽车。)

analysis.usage_difference: hold 指拿着、握住（持续状态），还可指举办（会议）；catch 指抓住（瞬间动作）、赶上（车）、接住。
analysis.collocation: hold on；hold a meeting；catch the bus；catch up with
analysis.summary: 握着用 hold；一把抓住、赶车用 catch。

members.example: She prepared a special gift for her friend.(她为朋友准备了一份特别的礼物。)
It is unusual to see snow in this city.(在这座城市看到雪是不寻常的。)
I heard a strange noise outside the window last night.(昨晚我听到窗外有奇怪的声音。)

analysis.usage_difference: special 指特别的、特殊的（褒义）；unusual 指不寻常的（中性）；strange 指奇怪的、陌生的。
analysis.collocation: a special gift；an unusual experience；a strange man
analysis.summary: 特别的用 special；不寻常的用 unusual；奇怪陌生用 strange。

members.gloss: v.关心; 在意. n.照顾; 关怀.
members.example: We should care about the old people around us.(我们应该关心身边的老人。)

members.gloss: n.头脑; 想法. v.介意; 注意.
members.example: Would you mind opening the window?(你介意打开窗户吗？)

analysis.usage_difference: care 指关心、在意（care about/for）；mind 指介意，常用于疑问句“你介意吗”，也可作名词“头脑、想法”。
analysis.collocation: care about；take care of；Would you mind doing…?；Never mind.
analysis.summary: 关心照顾用 care(of/about)；介意用 mind。

members.example: What a beautiful day it is today!(今天天气多好啊！)

members.gloss: adj.可爱的；令人愉快的；美丽的.
members.example: What a lovely day it is!(多么美好的一天啊！)

analysis.usage_difference: beautiful 指美丽的，语气最强，可形容人、景、物；lovely 指可爱的、令人愉快的，语气亲切。
analysis.collocation: a beautiful park；a lovely girl
analysis.summary: 美丽用 beautiful；可爱怡人用 lovely。

members.example: This song is very popular among young people.(这首歌在年轻人中很受欢迎。)
Pop music is very popular among young people.(流行音乐在年轻人中很受欢迎。)

analysis.usage_difference: popular 指流行的、受欢迎的（be popular with/among）；pop 指流行音乐（pop music），是 popular 的缩略。
analysis.collocation: be popular with；pop music
analysis.summary: 受欢迎用 popular；流行音乐用 pop。

members.example: I believe you can do it if you try your best.(我相信如果你尽力就能做到。)

members.gloss: v.信任; 相信. n.信任; 信赖.
members.example: You can trust me — I will keep your secret.(你可以信任我——我会替你保守秘密。)

members.gloss: v.猜想; 认为; 假设.
members.example: I suppose he is right about this matter.(我认为他在这件事上是对的。)

members.gloss: v.猜测; 推测. n.猜测.
members.example: Can you guess what's in my hand?(你能猜猜我手里是什么吗？)

members.gloss: n.怀疑; 疑问. v.怀疑.
members.example: There is no doubt that he is a good student.(毫无疑问他是个好学生。)
Can you imagine life without the Internet?(你能想象没有互联网的生活吗？)

analysis.pos_difference: believe：v.（动词）；trust：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；suppose：v.（动词）；guess：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；doubt：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；imagine：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: believe 指相信某事为真；trust 指信任某人（人品）；suppose 指猜想、认为（be supposed to 应该）；guess 指无把握的猜测；doubt 指怀疑、不信；imagine 指想象。
analysis.collocation: believe in；trust sb.；be supposed to do；guess the answer；doubt whether…；imagine doing
analysis.summary: 相信用 believe；信任人用 trust；认为用 suppose；瞎猜用 guess；怀疑用 doubt；想象用 imagine。

members.gloss: n.计划; 方案. v.计划; 打算.
members.example: What's your plan for the summer holiday?(你暑假有什么计划？)
We need to prepare for the final exam.(我们需要为期末考试做准备。)

members.gloss: n.目标；目的. v.瞄准；旨在.
members.example: His aim is to become a doctor in the future.(他的目标是将来成为一名医生。)

analysis.usage_difference: plan 指计划、打算；prepare 指为…做准备；aim 指目标，作动词指旨在、瞄准。
analysis.collocation: plan to do；prepare for；aim to do / aim at；the aim of
analysis.summary: 打算用 plan(to do)；备考用 prepare(for)；目标用 aim。

members.gloss: v.担心; 烦恼. n.担忧.
members.example: Don't worry about the exam. You'll be fine.(别担心考试。你会没事的。)
Don't be afraid of making mistakes.(不要害怕犯错。)
I always feel nervous before giving a speech.(演讲前我总是感到紧张。)

analysis.usage_difference: worry 指担心（worry about）；afraid 指害怕（be afraid of/to do）；nervous 指（考试、演讲前）紧张不安。
analysis.collocation: worry about；be afraid of；feel nervous
analysis.summary: 担心用 worry(about)；害怕用 afraid；紧张用 nervous。

members.example: Please send me an email when you arrive.(你到达后请给我发一封电子邮件。)
I received a birthday card from my friend.(我收到了朋友寄来的生日贺卡。)
Please write your address on the envelope.(请在信封上写上你的地址。)

analysis.usage_difference: send 指寄出、发送；receive 指（客观）收到；envelope 指信封。
analysis.collocation: send sth. to sb. / send sb. sth.；receive a letter；an envelope
analysis.summary: 寄发用 send；收到用 receive；信封装信封 envelope。

members.example: She accepted my invitation to the birthday party.(她接受了我的生日聚会邀请。)

members.gloss: v.同意; 赞成; 一致.
members.example: I agree with you on this point.(在这一点上我同意你的看法。)
He refused to lend me his bicycle.(他拒绝把自行车借给我。)
We are not allowed to use phones in class.(我们不被允许在课堂上使用手机。)

analysis.usage_difference: accept 指（主观愿意）接受，与 receive（客观收到）相对；agree 指同意（agree with/to do）；refuse 指拒绝；allow 指允许。
analysis.collocation: accept an invitation；agree with sb. / agree to do；refuse to do；allow sb. to do
analysis.summary: 接受用 accept；同意用 agree；拒绝用 refuse(to do)；允许用 allow(sb. to do)。

members.gloss: v.等待; 等候. n.等待.
members.example: Please wait for me at the school gate.(请在学校门口等我。)
I expect you to finish the work on time.(我期望你按时完成工作。)

members.gloss: v.希望. n.希望; 期望.
members.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party.(我希望你能来参加我的生日聚会。)

members.gloss: v.希望; 祝愿. n.愿望; 祝福.
members.example: I wish you a happy birthday!(我祝你生日快乐！)

analysis.pos_difference: wait：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；expect：v.（动词）；hope：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；wish：v.（动词）、n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: wait 指等待（wait for）；expect 指预期某事会发生；hope 指希望（hope to do/that，不接 sb. to do）；wish 指难以实现的愿望或祝愿（wish sb. sth.）。
analysis.collocation: wait for；expect sb. to do；hope to do / hope that…；wish sb. good luck
analysis.summary: 等待用 wait(for)；预料用 expect；希望用 hope（不能说 hope sb. to do）；祝愿用 wish。

members.example: He decided to study abroad after graduation.(他决定毕业后出国留学。)
Making the right decision is not always easy.(做出正确的决定并不总是容易的。)

analysis.usage_difference: decide 是动词，指决定（decide to do）；decision 是名词（make a decision）。
analysis.collocation: decide to do / decide on；make a decision
analysis.summary: 动词决定用 decide；名词用 decision。

members.example: You can choose any book you like from the shelf.(你可以从书架上选择任何你喜欢的书。)

members.gloss: v.挑选; 捡起; 采摘. n.挑选.
members.example: She picked some flowers from the garden.(她从花园里摘了一些花。)

analysis.usage_difference: choose 指选择、挑选（choose from/between），较正式；pick 口语中更常用，还可指捡起、采摘。
analysis.collocation: choose…from/between；pick up；pick apples
analysis.summary: 挑选用 choose/pick；“捡起、摘”用 pick up/pick。

members.example: He lost his keys on the way home.(他在回家的路上丢了钥匙。)
I really miss my grandparents in the countryside.(我真的很想念在乡下的爷爷奶奶。)
He failed the English exam because he didn't study hard.(他英语考试不及格，因为没有努力学习。)

analysis.usage_difference: lose 指丢失、输掉（比赛）；miss 指错过（车、机会）、想念；fail 指失败、考试不及格（fail to do 未能做到）。
analysis.collocation: lose one's way；lose the game；miss the bus；fail the exam；fail to do
analysis.summary: 丢失、输用 lose；错过想念用 miss；失败不及格用 fail。

members.gloss: adv.相当; 十分; 完全.
members.example: The movie was quite interesting.(这部电影相当有趣。)
Do we have enough time to finish the work?(我们有足够的时间完成这项工作吗？)

members.gloss: adv.真正地; 实际上; 确实.
members.example: This movie is really interesting. You should watch it.(这部电影真的很有趣。你应该看看。)

analysis.usage_difference: quite 指相当、十分（quite + adj.）；enough 指足够，修饰形容词副词时后置（big enough）；really 指真正地、确实（加强语气）。
analysis.collocation: quite good；good enough；enough time
analysis.summary: 相当用 quite 前置；足够用 enough，形副后置、名词前置。

members.gloss: v.离开; 留下; 遗忘.
members.example: She left home early this morning to catch the bus.(她今天一大早就出门去赶公交车了。)

members.gloss: v.返回; 归还. n.回来; 归还.
members.example: Please return the book to the library on time.(请按时把书还给图书馆。)

analysis.usage_difference: leave 指离开（leave for 动身去）、留下、遗忘（把某物落在某处）；return 指返回、归还（return to / return sth. to sb.）。
analysis.collocation: leave for Beijing；leave sth. at home；return to；return sth. to sb.
analysis.summary: 离开、落下用 leave；回来、归还用 return。

members.example: We should save water and electricity in daily life.(我们在日常生活中应该节约水电。)

members.gloss: v.浪费. n.浪费；废物. adj.废弃的.
members.example: Don't waste water — turn off the tap when you brush your teeth.(不要浪费水——刷牙时关上水龙头。)

members.gloss: adj.备用的; 空闲的. v.抽出; 饶恕.
members.example: I like to read books in my spare time.(我喜欢在空闲时间读书。)

analysis.pos_difference: save：v.（动词）；waste：v.（动词）、n.（名词）、adj.（形容词）；spare：adj.（形容词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: save 指节省、储蓄、拯救；waste 指浪费（时间、金钱）；spare 指备用的、空闲的，作动词指抽出（时间）。
analysis.collocation: save money/water/lives；a waste of time；waste time doing；spare time；spare no effort
analysis.summary: 节省救人用 save；浪费用 waste；空闲抽出用 spare。

members.example: He worked very hard. However, he failed the exam.(他学习非常努力。然而，他考试没及格。)
It was raining, but we went to the park anyway.(虽然下着雨，但我们还是去了公园。)

analysis.usage_difference: however 指然而，表转折，位置灵活；anyway 指无论如何、总之，常用于转换话题或收尾。
analysis.collocation: However, …；anyway, …
analysis.summary: 转折用 however；不管怎么说用 anyway。

members.gloss: adv.后来; 稍后. adj.后来的.
members.example: See you later at the bus stop.(稍后公交车站见。)

members.gloss: adj.晚的; 迟的. adv.迟; 晚.
members.example: Don't be late for school again.(不要再上学迟到了。)
I've already finished my homework.(我已经完成作业了。)
I haven't seen him recently.(我最近没见过他。)
Nowadays, most people use smartphones.(如今，大多数人使用智能手机。)
Please come here immediately.(请立刻到这里来。)
Suddenly, it started to rain heavily.(突然，开始下起了大雨。)
There was a sudden change in the weather yesterday.(昨天天气突然变了。)

analysis.pos_difference: later：adv.（副词）、adj.（形容词）；late：adj.（形容词）、adv.（副词）；already：adv.（副词）；recently：adv.（副词）；nowadays：adv.（副词）；immediately：adv.（副词）；suddenly：adv.（副词）；sudden：adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: later 指后来、稍后；late 指迟、晚（be late for）；already 指已经（肯定句）；recently 指最近（常与完成时连用）；nowadays 指现今；immediately 指立刻；suddenly 指突然地，sudden 是其形容词。
analysis.collocation: later on；be late for；have already done；in recent years；right now/immediately；all of a sudden
analysis.summary: 稍后 later、迟到 late、已经 already、最近 recently、如今 nowadays、立刻 immediately、突然 suddenly。

members.example: They are building a new library in our school.(他们正在我们学校建一座新图书馆。)
There are many tall buildings in the city center.(市中心有很多高楼。)

members.gloss: v.修理; 补救. n.修理.
members.example: My father repaired the broken chair by himself.(我父亲自己修好了那把坏椅子。)
My father is fixing the broken chair.(我爸爸正在修理那把坏椅子。)
My grandmother helped me mend my torn shirt.(奶奶帮我缝补了破了的衬衫。)

analysis.pos_difference: build：v.（动词）；building：n.（名词）；repair：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；fix：v.（动词）；mend：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: build 指建造（大型建筑），building 指建筑物；repair 指修理（较大物件，较正式）；fix 指修理、安装、固定（口语常用）；mend 指修补（衣物、小物件）。
analysis.collocation: build a bridge；a tall building；repair a car；fix the computer；mend shoes
analysis.summary: 建造用 build；修理用 repair/fix（口语）；缝补用 mend。

members.example: There are many after-school activities in our school.(我们学校有很多课外活动。)
His behavior in class has improved a lot this term.(这学期他在课堂上的表现进步了很多。)

analysis.usage_difference: activity 指（有组织的）活动；behavior 指行为、举止（品行）。
analysis.collocation: after-school activities；good/bad behavior
analysis.summary: 课外活动用 activity；行为举止用 behavior。

members.example: What happened to you yesterday?(你昨天怎么了？)
The sun appeared from behind the clouds.(太阳从云层后面出现了。)
He seems very happy today.(他今天看起来很开心。)

analysis.usage_difference: happen 指（偶然）发生（happen to do 碰巧）；appear 指出现、显得；seem 指似乎（seem to do / It seems that…）。
analysis.collocation: What happened?；happen to do；appear/seem to be；It seems that…
analysis.summary: 发生用 happen；出现用 appear；似乎用 seem。

members.gloss: v.打破; 弄坏. n.休息; 课间.
members.example: Be careful! Don't break the glass.(小心！别打碎玻璃杯。)

members.gloss: v.损害; 毁坏. n.损害; 赔偿金.
members.example: The storm damaged many houses in the village.(暴风雨损坏了村里的许多房屋。)
The fire destroyed several houses in the village.(大火烧毁了村里的几座房子。)

analysis.usage_difference: break 指打破、弄坏（也可作名词“休息”）；damage 指局部损坏，可修复；destroy 指彻底毁坏，无法修复。
analysis.collocation: break the window；break down；damage the crops；destroy the village
analysis.summary: 打碎用 break；损坏用 damage；毁灭用 destroy。

members.example: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.(春节是中国最重要的节日。)
How do you celebrate the Spring Festival?(你们怎么庆祝春节？)
Please write down your date of birth on this form.(请在这张表格上写下你的出生日期。)

analysis.usage_difference: festival 指节日；celebrate 指庆祝；birth 指出生（birthday 生日）。
analysis.collocation: the Spring Festival；celebrate one's birthday；date of birth
analysis.summary: 节日用 festival；庆祝用 celebrate；出生用 birth。

members.example: English is a useful language to learn.(英语是一门有用的语言。)
What does this word mean in Chinese?(这个单词用中文是什么意思？)

members.gloss: v.表达; 表示. n.快递; 快车.
members.example: It's hard to express my feelings in words.(很难用语言表达我的感受。)

members.gloss: n.表情; 表达; 词语.
members.example: There was a surprised expression on her face.(她脸上露出惊讶的表情。)
Can you pronounce this word for me?(你能帮我读一下这个单词吗？)
Good communication is important in a team.(良好的沟通在团队中很重要。)

analysis.pos_difference: language：n.（名词）；mean：v.（动词）；express：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；expression：n.（名词）；pronounce：v.（动词）；communication：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: language 指语言；mean 指意思是、意味着；express 指表达（感情、观点），expression 是其名词，也可指“表情、词语”；pronounce 指发音；communication 指交流、通讯。
analysis.collocation: foreign languages；mean doing/to do；express oneself；facial expression；pronounce the word；communicate/communication with
analysis.summary: 语言用 language；“意思是”用 mean；表达用 express；发音用 pronounce；交流用 communication。

members.example: Can you give me an example?(你能给我举个例子吗？)

members.gloss: n.情况; 案例; 箱子.
members.example: In that case, I'll go with you.(既然如此，我和你一起去。)

analysis.usage_difference: example 指例子、榜样（for example 例如）；case 指具体情况、案例、案件，也可指箱子。
analysis.collocation: for example；set an example；in this case；in case of
analysis.summary: 举例用 example；“具体情况、案例”用 case。

members.gloss: adj.健康的; 有益健康的.
members.example: Eating fruit and vegetables is healthy.(吃水果和蔬菜有益健康。)
He missed a lot of school because of his illness.(他因为生病缺了很多课。)
Washing hands often can prevent disease.(经常洗手可以预防疾病。)

members.gloss: n.病人; 患者. adj.耐心的.
members.example: A good teacher must be patient with students.(一个好老师必须对学生有耐心。)
The medical team helped many sick people in the village.(医疗队帮助了村里很多生病的人。)
The doctor told him to take the drug three times a day.(医生告诉他一天吃三次药。)
She had a high fever and stayed in bed all day.(她发高烧，在床上躺了一整天。)
He has been coughing for a whole week.(他已经咳嗽整整一个星期了。)
I have a terrible toothache and need to see a dentist.(我牙疼得厉害，需要去看牙医。)
My head aches because I didn't sleep well last night.(我头疼，因为昨晚没睡好。)
Smoking can increase the risk of getting cancer.(吸烟会增加患癌症的风险。)
She went to the clinic to see a doctor this morning.(她今天早上去诊所看了医生。)
I need to see a dentist because my tooth hurts.(我需要去看牙医，因为我牙疼。)

analysis.pos_difference: healthy：adj.（形容词）；illness：n.（名词）；disease：n.（名词）；patient：n.（名词）、adj.（形容词）；medical：adj.（形容词）；drug：n.（名词）；fever：n.（名词）；cough：n.（名词）；toothache：n.（名词）；ache：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；cancer：n.（名词）；clinic：n.（名词）；dentist：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: healthy 指健康的；illness 泛指疾病（状态）；disease 指（具体的）疾病、病症；patient 指病人（作形容词指耐心的）；medical 指医疗的；drug 指药（也可指毒品）；fever 发烧、cough 咳嗽、toothache 牙痛、ache 疼痛、cancer 癌症，都是具体病症；clinic 指诊所；dentist 指牙医。
analysis.collocation: keep healthy；a serious illness/disease；see a doctor/patient；medical care；take medicine/drugs；have a fever/cough/toothache；go to the clinic/dentist
analysis.summary: 健康用 healthy；生病状态用 illness；具体疾病用 disease；病人用 patient；“头痛/牙痛”用 -ache 合成词。

members.gloss: v.分享; 共用. n.份额; 股份.
members.example: Let me share this story with you.(让我和你分享这个故事。)
The teacher divided the class into four groups.(老师把全班分成了四组。)
Please separate the waste into different groups.(请把垃圾分成不同的类别。)
Mix the flour and eggs together to make a cake.(把面粉和鸡蛋混合在一起做蛋糕。)

analysis.usage_difference: share 指分享、共用（share sth. with sb.）；divide 指把整体分成若干份（divide…into）；separate 指把连在一起的东西分开（separate…from）；mix 是其反义“混合”。
analysis.collocation: share…with；divide…into；separate…from；mix…with
analysis.summary: 分享用 share(with)；划分用 divide(into)；分离用 separate(from)；混合用 mix。

members.gloss: v.品尝; 尝起来. n.味道; 品味.
members.example: The soup tastes delicious.(这汤尝起来很美味。)
Something smells really good in the kitchen.(厨房里闻起来真香。)
The lemon tastes very sour.(这个柠檬尝起来很酸。)
This medicine tastes very bitter, but it works well.(这药尝起来很苦，但效果很好。)

analysis.pos_difference: taste：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；smell：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；sour：adj.（形容词）；bitter：adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: taste 指品尝、尝起来；smell 指闻、闻起来、气味；sour 指酸的；bitter 指苦的（也可指痛苦的）。
analysis.collocation: taste good/delicious；smell nice；sour grapes；bitter medicine
analysis.summary: 尝用 taste；闻用 smell；酸用 sour；苦用 bitter。

members.example: My father works for a big company.(我爸爸在一家大公司工作。)

members.gloss: n.商业; 生意; 事务.
members.example: His father runs a small business.(他爸爸经营一家小生意。)
My uncle works in a car factory.(我叔叔在一家汽车工厂工作。)
The car industry is very important to the country's economy.(汽车工业对国家经济非常重要。)

members.gloss: n.贸易; 行业. v.做买卖.
members.example: China has trade with many countries around the world.(中国与世界上许多国家有贸易往来。)
The trader sells fruit and vegetables at the market.(这个商人在市场上卖水果和蔬菜。)
My mother goes to the market every morning.(我妈妈每天早上去市场。)
The store is having a big sale this weekend.(这家商店本周末大促销。)
This company makes high-quality products.(这家公司生产高质量的产品。)
There are over twenty items on the shopping list.(购物清单上有二十多个项目。)

members.gloss: adj.公平的; 合理的. n.展览会; 集市.
members.example: The teacher is always fair to every student.(老师对每个学生都很公平。)

analysis.pos_difference: company：n.（名词）；business：n.（名词）；factory：n.（名词）；industry：n.（名词）；trade：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；trader：n.（名词）；market：n.（名词）；sale：n.（名词）；product：n.（名词）；item：n.（名词）；fair：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: company 指公司（也可指陪伴）；business 指商业、生意、事务；factory 指工厂；industry 指（整个）工业、产业；trade 指贸易，trader 指商人；market 指市场；sale 指出售、促销（on sale）；product 指产品；item 指一件商品、一个项目；fair 指集市、展览会。
analysis.collocation: run a company；do business；work in a factory；the car industry；international trade；on the market；on sale；produce products
analysis.summary: 公司用 company；生意用 business；工厂用 factory；产业用 industry；贸易用 trade；市场用 market；出售促销用 sale。

members.gloss: v.关闭; 结束. adj.近的; 亲密的. adv.接近地.
members.example: Please close the door when you leave.(你离开时请关上门。)
Please shut the door when you go out.(出去的时候请把门关上。)

analysis.usage_difference: close 指关闭（也可作形容词“近的、亲密的”）；shut 与 close 同义，口气更强，过去式过去分词仍为 shut。
analysis.collocation: close/shut the door；close down；shut up
analysis.summary: 关门用 close/shut；“闭嘴”用 shut up；“亲近的”用 close。

members.gloss: n.光; 灯. adj.轻的; 明亮的.
members.example: Please turn on the light; it's too dark.(请开灯，太暗了。)

members.gloss: adj.明亮的; 聪明的; 鲜艳的.
members.example: The stars are very bright tonight.(今晚的星星非常明亮。)
The sun is shining brightly in the sky.(太阳在天空中明亮地照耀着。)
A flash of lightning lit up the dark sky.(一道闪电照亮了黑暗的天空。)

analysis.pos_difference: light：n.（名词）、adj.（形容词）；bright：adj.（形容词）；shine：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；flash：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: light 指光、灯（作形容词指轻的、明亮的）；bright 指明亮的（也可指聪明的）；shine 指照耀、发光；flash 指闪光、一闪而过。
analysis.collocation: turn on the light；bright sunshine；The sun shines.；a flash of lightning
analysis.summary: 灯光用 light；明亮用 bright；照耀用 shine；闪光用 flash。

members.gloss: v.站立; 忍受. n.看台; 立场.
members.example: I can't stand the noise outside.(我无法忍受外面的噪音。)
Many people suffered from the cold weather last winter.(去年冬天很多人遭受了寒冷天气之苦。)

analysis.usage_difference: stand 指站立，口语中也指忍受（can't stand doing）；suffer 指遭受（痛苦、损失），常接 from（患病）。
analysis.collocation: stand up；can't stand doing；suffer from；suffer a loss
analysis.summary: 站立用 stand；“受不了”用 can't stand；遭罪患病用 suffer(from)。

members.example: The good news excited everyone in the class.(这个好消息让全班同学都很兴奋。)
The magic show amazed all the children.(魔术表演让所有孩子都惊叹不已。)

analysis.usage_difference: excite 指使兴奋（excited 感到兴奋的，exciting 令人兴奋的）；amaze 指使大为惊奇。
analysis.collocation: be excited about；be amazed at/by
analysis.summary: 兴奋用 excite(-ed/-ing)；惊叹用 amaze(-d)。

members.example: In my opinion, reading is the best way to learn.(在我看来，阅读是最好的学习方式。)

members.gloss: n.风景; 看法; 视野. v.观看; 认为.
members.example: The view from the top of the mountain is wonderful.(山顶上的景色太美了。)
Your attitude towards study will decide your future.(你对学习的态度将决定你的未来。)
The team showed great spirit during the competition.(团队在比赛中展现了伟大的精神。)

analysis.usage_difference: mind（见“关心与介意”组）也指头脑、想法（make up one's mind 下定决心）；opinion 指意见、看法（in one's opinion）；view 指观点，也可指风景、视野；attitude 指态度（attitude to/towards）；spirit 指精神、心灵。
analysis.collocation: change one's mind；in one's opinion；point of view；attitude to/towards；team spirit
analysis.summary: 想法心思用 mind；看法用 opinion/view；态度用 attitude；精神用 spirit。

members.gloss: n.顺序; 命令; 订单. v.命令; 点(菜).
members.example: The teacher asked us to sit in order.(老师让我们按顺序坐好。)
Please read the instructions carefully before using this machine.(使用这台机器前请仔细阅读说明。)

analysis.usage_difference: order 指命令、点餐、订单（in order to 为了）；instruction 指（常用复数）操作说明、指示。
analysis.collocation: order a meal；follow the instructions；in order to
analysis.summary: 命令、点菜用 order；说明书、指示用 instructions。

members.gloss: v.落下; 跌倒; 降低. n.秋天; 下落.
members.example: Be careful not to fall on the wet floor.(小心别在湿地板上滑倒。)
Don't lie to your parents.(不要对父母说谎。)
The hen lays an egg every day.(这只母鸡每天下一个蛋。)
She hung a picture on the wall.(她在墙上挂了一幅画。)

analysis.pos_difference: fall：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；lie：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；lay：v.（动词）；hang：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: fall 指落下、跌倒（fell, fallen）；lie 指躺、位于（lay, lain），也可指说谎（lied）；lay 指放置、下蛋（laid, laid），是 lie(躺) 的过去式同形词；hang 指悬挂（hung, hung）。
analysis.collocation: fall down/off；lie down；lay the table；lay eggs；hang up
analysis.summary: 落下用 fall；躺用 lie(lay, lain)；放置下蛋用 lay(laid)；悬挂用 hang(hung)。

members.gloss: v.收集; 收藏; 领取.
members.example: My brother likes to collect stamps.(我哥哥喜欢集邮。)

members.gloss: n.商店; 储存. v.储存; 储备.
members.example: There is a book store near our school.(我们学校附近有一家书店。)

analysis.usage_difference: collect 指收集、收藏（爱好性）；store 指储存、储备（作名词指商店）。
analysis.collocation: collect stamps；store food/information
analysis.summary: 收藏爱好品用 collect；储存物资信息用 store。

members.example: What's the weather like today?(今天天气怎么样？)

members.gloss: adj.阳光充足的; 晴朗的.
members.example: It's a sunny day. Let's go for a walk.(今天阳光明媚，我们去散步吧。)
It has been rainy all week.(整个星期都在下雨。)
It was cloudy all day, but it didn't rain.(一整天都是阴天，但没有下雨。)
My clothes got wet in the rain.(我的衣服在雨中淋湿了。)
I usually take a shower before going to bed.(我通常在睡前洗个淋浴。)

analysis.pos_difference: weather：n.（名词）；sunny：adj.（形容词）；rainy：adj.（形容词）；cloudy：adj.（形容词）；wet：adj.（形容词）；shower：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: weather 是不可数名词“天气”；sunny 晴朗的、rainy 多雨的、cloudy 多云的、wet 潮湿多雨的，均为形容词；shower 指阵雨（也可指淋浴）。
analysis.collocation: fine weather；a sunny/rainy/cloudy day；get wet；a heavy shower
analysis.summary: 天气用 weather；晴/雨/阴分别用 sunny/rainy/cloudy；阵雨用 shower。

members.example: We should protect the environment.(我们应该保护环境。)

members.gloss: v.守卫；保护. n.警卫；哨兵.
members.example: A guard stood at the gate of the museum.(一名警卫站在博物馆门口。)

analysis.usage_difference: protect 指保护（protect…from/against）；guard 指守卫、警卫（也可作名词指卫兵）。
analysis.collocation: protect the environment；guard the gate；a security guard
analysis.summary: 保护环境用 protect(from)；站岗守卫用 guard。

members.gloss: n.机会; 可能性; 偶然.
members.example: You should take the chance to study abroad.(你应该抓住出国学习的机会。)

members.gloss: n.挑战; 难题. v.挑战; 质疑.
members.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge.(学习一门新语言是一个很大的挑战。)

analysis.usage_difference: chance 指机会、可能性（by chance 偶然）；challenge 指挑战（也可作动词）。
analysis.collocation: a good chance；by chance；face/meet a challenge
analysis.summary: 机会用 chance；挑战用 challenge。

members.example: Reading can help improve your English.(阅读可以帮助你提高英语水平。)

members.gloss: v.发展; 开发; 培养.
members.example: China is developing very fast.(中国发展得非常快。)

members.gloss: v.增加; 增长. n.增加; 增长.
members.example: The number of students in our school has increased this year.(今年我们学校的学生人数增加了。)

members.gloss: v.减少; 缩小; 降低.
members.example: We should reduce the use of plastic bags.(我们应该减少使用塑料袋。)

analysis.usage_difference: improve 指改善、提高（质量）；develop 指发展、开发、培养；increase 指增加；reduce 指减少。
analysis.collocation: improve English；develop a habit；increase/reduce the price

members.example: We must do something to protect the environment.(我们必须采取行动保护环境。)

analysis.pos_difference: strong：adj.（形容词）；weak：adj.（形容词）；power：n.（名词）；force：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: strong 指强壮的、强烈的；weak 是其反义；power 指力量、权力、电力；force 指武力、作用力，作动词指强迫。

analysis.usage_difference: head 指头；heart 指心脏、内心；shoulder 指肩膀（作动词指肩负）；wing 指翅膀；blood 指血液；physical 指身体的（也可指物理的）。

analysis.usage_difference: hurt 指弄伤、疼痛（hurt-hurt-hurt）；burn 指烧伤、燃烧。

members.gloss: v.对待; 治疗; 款待. n.款待; 乐事.

analysis.pos_difference: invite：v.（动词）；invitation：n.（名词）；treat：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；greet：v.（动词）；introduce：v.（动词）；regard：n.（名词）。
