members.gloss: v.后悔; 遗憾. n.遗憾; 懊悔.
members.example: I regret not studying harder when I was young.(我后悔年轻时没有更努力学习。)

analysis.usage_difference: pity 指遗憾、怜悯（What a pity!）；shame 指羞耻、遗憾的事；regret 指后悔（regret doing 后悔做过）。
analysis.collocation: What a pity!；It's a shame that…；regret doing
analysis.summary: 真可惜用 pity/shame；后悔用 regret(doing)。

members.example: We are proud of our country.(我们为我们的国家感到自豪。)
She takes great pride in her work.(她为自己的工作感到非常自豪。)

analysis.usage_difference: proud 是形容词“自豪的”（be proud of）；pride 是名词（take pride in）。
analysis.collocation: be proud of；take pride in
analysis.summary: 为…自豪：be proud of = take pride in。

members.gloss: n.服务；服役. v.维修；保养.
members.example: The service in this hotel is excellent.(这家酒店的服务非常好。)
In old times, rich families usually had many servants.(在古代，富人家庭通常有很多仆人。)
The waiter brought us the menu.(服务员给我们拿来了菜单。)

analysis.usage_difference: service 指服务（作动词指维修保养）；servant 指仆人；waiter 指（餐厅）服务员。
analysis.collocation: good service；public service；ask the waiter
analysis.summary: 服务用 service；仆人用 servant；餐厅服务员用 waiter。

members.example: Hard work is the key to success.(努力是成功的关键。)
She is a successful businesswoman.(她是一位成功的女商人。)
If you work hard, you will succeed.(如果你努力，你就会成功。)
She worked hard and achieved her dream of becoming a doctor.(她努力学习，实现了成为医生的梦想。)
Winning the competition was a great achievement for our team.(赢得比赛对我们团队来说是一项了不起的成就。)
The team celebrated their victory in the final game.(球队庆祝他们在决赛中的胜利。)

analysis.pos_difference: success：n.（名词）；successful：adj.（形容词）；succeed：v.（动词）；achieve：v.（动词）；achievement：n.（名词）；victory：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: success 是名词；successful 是形容词（be successful in）；succeed 是动词（succeed in doing）；achieve 指（经努力）实现目标，achievement 是其名词“成就”；victory 指（比赛、战争的）胜利。
analysis.collocation: achieve success；be successful in；succeed in doing；achieve one's dream；a great achievement；win a victory
analysis.summary: 成功：名词 success、形容词 successful、动词 succeed(in doing)；实现梦想用 achieve；比赛胜利用 victory。

members.gloss: n.结果；成绩. v.导致；产生.
members.example: He studied hard, and as a result he passed the exam.(他努力学习，结果通过了考试。)

members.gloss: n.影响; 效果; 结果.
members.example: Smoking has a bad effect on your health.(吸烟对你的健康有不良影响。)

members.gloss: n.影响; 影响力. v.影响.
members.example: Parents have a great influence on their children.(父母对孩子有很大的影响。)

analysis.usage_difference: result 指结果（as a result 因此）；effect 指效果、作用（have an effect on）；influence 指（深远的、潜移默化的）影响。
analysis.collocation: as a result；have an effect/influence on
analysis.summary: 结果用 result；效果用 effect；深远影响用 influence。

members.gloss: n.练习；实践. v.练习；实行.
members.example: Practice makes perfect.(熟能生巧。)

members.gloss: n.运动；练习；习题. v.锻炼；运动.
members.example: Doing exercise every day is good for your health.(每天锻炼对你的健康有好处。)

members.gloss: n.教练; 长途汽车. v.训练; 指导.
members.example: Our basketball coach is very strict.(我们的篮球教练非常严格。)

analysis.pos_difference: practice：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；exercise：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；coach：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: practice 指练习（practice doing）；exercise 指运动、体操、习题；coach 指教练，作动词指训练指导。
analysis.collocation: practice speaking English；do exercise/morning exercises；a football coach
analysis.summary: 练技能用 practice(doing)；锻炼做操用 exercise；教练用 coach。

members.example: Reading is an important skill for every student.(阅读对每个学生来说都是一项重要的技能。)
She has the ability to learn languages quickly.(她有快速学习语言的能力。)

members.gloss: n.天赋; 才能; 人才.
members.example: She has a talent for painting.(她有绘画天赋。)
He was able to solve the problem by himself.(他能够自己解决这个问题。)

analysis.usage_difference: skill 指（后天练成的）技能；ability 指能力（the ability to do）；talent 指天赋；able 是形容词（be able to do 能够）。
analysis.collocation: learn a skill；the ability to do；have a talent for；be able to do
analysis.summary: 技能用 skill；能力用 ability（be able to）；天赋用 talent。

members.gloss: v.休息；歇息. n.休息；其余的.
members.example: You look tired — you should take a rest.(你看起来很累——你应该休息一下。)
I usually wake up at six o'clock every morning.(我通常每天早上六点醒来。)

analysis.usage_difference: rest 指休息（have a rest），也可指“其余的部分”；wake 指醒来、唤醒（wake up）。
analysis.collocation: have/take a rest；the rest of；wake up
analysis.summary: 休息用 rest；醒来用 wake(up)。

members.example: The people in this town are very friendly.(这个小镇上的人非常友好。)
It is polite to say "thank you" when someone helps you.(别人帮助你时说“谢谢“是有礼貌的。)
It is rude to talk loudly in the library.(在图书馆大声说话是不礼貌的。)
She spoke to the child in a gentle voice.(她用温柔的声音和孩子说话。)
It is cruel to keep wild animals in small cages.(把野生动物关在小笼子里是残忍的。)

analysis.pos_difference: friendly：adj.（形容词）；polite：adj.（形容词）；rude：adj.（形容词）；gentle：adj.（形容词）；cruel：adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: friendly 指友好的（be friendly to）；kind（见“种类”组）作形容词指善良的、和蔼的；polite 指有礼貌的；rude 指粗鲁的；gentle 指温和的、轻柔的；cruel 指残忍的。
analysis.collocation: be friendly/kind/polite/rude to sb.；a gentle voice；be cruel to
analysis.summary: 友好 friendly；善良 kind；礼貌 polite；粗鲁 rude；温和 gentle；残忍 cruel。

members.gloss: n.交易；协议. v.处理；对付.
members.example: We need to deal with this problem right away.(我们需要马上处理这个问题。)
Can you help me solve this math problem?(你能帮我解答这道数学题吗？)
We must find a solution to this problem.(我们必须找到这个问题的解决办法。)
She overcame many difficulties and finally succeeded.(她克服了许多困难，最终成功了。)

analysis.usage_difference: deal 指处理（deal with）；solve 指解决（问题、谜题）；solution 是其名词（the solution to）；overcome 指克服（困难、恐惧）。
analysis.collocation: deal with；solve the problem；the solution to；overcome difficulties
analysis.summary: 处理用 deal with；解题解决用 solve(solution to)；克服困难用 overcome。

members.example: The flowers will die without water.(花没有水就会枯死。)
The flowers are dead because nobody watered them.(花枯死了，因为没人浇水。)
The death of his pet made him very sad.(他宠物的死让他非常伤心。)

analysis.usage_difference: die 是动词（die of/from）；dead 是形容词（可表持续状态）；death 是名词。
analysis.collocation: die of illness；has been dead for years；the death of
analysis.summary: 动词死用 die；状态用 dead（与时间段连用）；名词用 death。

members.example: China is rich in natural resources.(中国自然资源丰富。)
Health is more important than wealth.(健康比财富更重要。)
This coat is too expensive for me to buy.(这件外套太贵了，我买不起。)
The books in this shop are very cheap.(这家店的书很便宜。)
Time is the most valuable thing we have.(时间是我们拥有的最宝贵的东西。)

members.gloss: n.价值; 重要性. v.重视; 估价.
members.example: We should value the time we spend with our family.(我们应该珍惜和家人在一起的时光。)

members.gloss: n.财宝; 珍品. v.珍惜; 珍爱.
members.example: We should treasure our friendship.(我们应该珍惜我们的友谊。)

analysis.pos_difference: rich：adj.（形容词）；wealth：n.（名词）；expensive：adj.（形容词）；cheap：adj.（形容词）；valuable：adj.（形容词）；value：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；treasure：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: rich 指富有的、丰富的；wealth 是名词“财富”；expensive 指昂贵的；cheap 是其反义；valuable 指有价值的、贵重的；value 是名词“价值”（作动词指重视）；treasure 指财宝，作动词指珍惜。
analysis.collocation: be rich in；a man of wealth；too expensive/cheap；valuable advice；the value of；treasure our friendship
analysis.summary: 富有 rich、财富 wealth；贵贱 expensive/cheap；有价值 valuable/value；珍宝珍惜 treasure。

members.example: The price of this book is thirty yuan.(这本书的价格是三十元。)
She won an award for her excellent performance.(她因出色的表现获得了一个奖项。)

members.gloss: n.报酬；奖赏. v.奖励；酬谢.
members.example: Hard work will bring its own reward in the end.(努力工作最终会带来回报。)
She won a gold medal in the swimming competition.(她在游泳比赛中获得了金牌。)
It is a great honor to be chosen as class monitor.(被选为班长是很大的荣誉。)

analysis.pos_difference: price：n.（名词）；award：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；reward：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；medal：n.（名词）；honor：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: price 指价格（价格高低用 high/low，不用 expensive）；award 指奖品，作动词指正式授予；reward 指报酬、酬谢；medal 指奖牌；honor 指荣誉。
analysis.collocation: the price of；win an award；a reward for；a gold medal；in honor of
analysis.summary: 价格用 price；获奖用 award；酬谢用 reward；奖牌用 medal；荣誉用 honor。

members.example: What time do you usually have supper?(你通常几点吃晚饭？)
Could I have a look at the menu, please?(请问我能看一下菜单吗？)
A healthy diet includes plenty of fruit and vegetables.(健康的饮食包括大量的水果和蔬菜。)
We bought a new rice cooker for the kitchen.(我们给厨房买了一个新的电饭锅。)
Please boil some water for tea.(请烧些水来泡茶。)
I'm so hungry that I could eat a horse.(我饿得能吃下一匹马。)
I'm very thirsty — can I have a glass of water?(我非常渴——能给我一杯水吗？)

analysis.pos_difference: supper：n.（名词）；menu：n.（名词）；diet：n.（名词）；cooker：n.（名词）；boil：v.（动词）；hungry：adj.（形容词）；thirsty：adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: supper 指晚餐；menu 指菜单；diet 指日常饮食、节食；cooker 指炊具（注意：厨师是 cook）；boil 指煮沸；hungry 指饥饿的；thirsty 指口渴的。
analysis.collocation: have supper；read the menu；on a diet；a rice cooker；boil water；be hungry/thirsty
analysis.summary: 晚饭 supper；菜单 menu；饮食节食 diet；锅具 cooker；煮沸 boil；饿 hungry；渴 thirsty。

members.example: Our neighbors are very kind and helpful.(我们的邻居非常善良且乐于助人。)
Our neighbours are very friendly and helpful.(我们的邻居非常友好而且乐于助人。)

analysis.usage_difference: 两词同义，neighbor 是美式拼写，neighbour 是英式拼写。
analysis.collocation: next-door neighbor/neighbour
analysis.summary: 美式 neighbor，英式 neighbour，意思完全相同。

members.gloss: pron.（两者之中）任一. adv.也（用于否定句）. conj.或者.
members.example: You can choose either the red one or the blue one.(你可以选红色的或蓝色的。)
Neither of the two answers is correct.(两个答案都不对。)

analysis.usage_difference: either 指（两者中）任一（either…or… 或者…或者…）；neither 指两者都不（neither…nor…）。
analysis.collocation: either…or…；neither…nor…
analysis.summary: 两者之一用 either(or)；两者都不用 neither(nor)。

members.gloss: adj.清楚的；清晰的；晴朗的. v.清除；放晴.
members.example: The instructions are very clear and easy to follow.(这些说明非常清楚，容易理解。)
Please tidy up your room before you go out.(出去之前请先整理好你的房间。)

members.gloss: v.打扫；清扫；席卷. n.打扫.
members.example: Please sweep the floor before you leave.(请在离开前把地扫一下。)

members.gloss: n.刷子; 画笔. v.刷; 擦.
members.example: Remember to brush your teeth before bed.(记得睡前刷牙。)
I usually take a hot bath before going to bed.(我通常在睡觉前洗个热水澡。)
Your room is in a mess. Please clean it up.(你的房间乱七八糟的，请打扫一下。)
Please put the rubbish in the bin.(请把垃圾放进垃圾桶。)
Please don't litter in the park.(请不要在公园里乱扔垃圾。)

analysis.pos_difference: clear：adj.（形容词）、v.（动词）；tidy：adj.（形容词）；sweep：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；brush：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；bath：n.（名词）；mess：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；rubbish：n.（名词）；litter：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: clear 作动词指清除（作形容词指清楚的）；tidy 指整洁的、整理；sweep 指打扫（swept）；brush 指刷；bath 指洗澡；mess 指脏乱；rubbish 与 litter 指垃圾，litter 作动词指乱扔。
analysis.collocation: clear the table；tidy up；sweep the floor；brush teeth；take a bath；in a mess；throw rubbish/litter about
analysis.summary: 整理用 tidy(up)；扫地 sweep；刷牙 brush；脏乱 mess；垃圾 rubbish/litter。

members.example: There was a traffic accident on the road this morning.(今天早上路上发生了一起交通事故。)
A strong earthquake hit the city last night.(昨晚一场强烈的地震袭击了这座城市。)
The heavy rain caused a terrible flood in the city.(暴雨在城市里引发了一场可怕的洪水。)

analysis.usage_difference: accident 指（交通等）意外事故；earthquake 指地震；flood 指洪水（作动词指淹没）。
analysis.collocation: a car/traffic accident；by accident；an earthquake；a flood
analysis.summary: 事故用 accident；地震用 earthquake；洪水用 flood。

members.gloss: adj.单独的；独自的. adv.单独地；仅仅.
members.example: She lives alone but she never feels lonely.(她独自生活，但从不觉得孤独。)
The old man felt lonely after his wife passed away.(老人在妻子去世后感到很孤独。)

members.gloss: adj.单一的; 单独的; 未婚的.
members.example: Every single student passed the exam.(每一个学生都通过了考试。)

analysis.usage_difference: alone 指独自一人（客观事实，不强调感情）；lonely 指孤独的（主观感受）；single 指单一的、单身的。
analysis.collocation: live alone；feel lonely；a single room
analysis.summary: 独自一人的客观状态用 alone；内心孤独用 lonely；单个单身用 single。

members.example: Wait a moment, please — I'll be right back.(请等一下——我马上回来。)
It takes me ten minutes to walk to school.(我步行去学校需要十分钟。)
We studied the history of this period in class.(我们在课堂上学习了这个时期的历史。)

analysis.usage_difference: moment 指片刻、瞬间（at the moment 此刻）；minute 指分钟；period 指一段时期、课时。
analysis.collocation: wait a moment；at the moment；in a few minutes；a period of time
analysis.summary: 片刻用 moment；分钟用 minute；时期用 period。

members.gloss: adj.整个的; 全部的. n.全部; 整体.
members.example: I spent the whole day reading this book.(我花了一整天读这本书。)
Most students like to play sports after school.(大多数学生喜欢放学后做运动。)

members.gloss: n.数量; 总额. v.总计; 相当于.
members.example: A large amount of money was spent on the project.(大量资金被花在了这个项目上。)

members.gloss: adj.几个的; 若干的. pron.几个.
members.example: I have read this book several times.(这本书我已经读了好几遍了。)
She bought two dozen eggs from the market.(她从市场买了两打鸡蛋。)
The population of our city is about five million.(我们城市的人口大约五百万。)

analysis.pos_difference: whole：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）；most：adv.（副词）、adj.（形容词）；amount：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；several：adj.（形容词）、pron.（代词）；dozen：n.（名词）；population：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: whole 指整个的（the whole + 名词）；most 指大多数、最；amount 指数量（an amount of + 不可数）；several 指几个；dozen 指一打（十二个）；population 指人口。
analysis.collocation: the whole day；most of；a large amount of；several times；two dozen eggs；the population of
analysis.summary: 整个用 whole；大多数用 most；数量用 amount of（不可数）；几个用 several；人口用 population。

members.gloss: v.绘画; 涂漆. n.油漆; 颜料.
members.example: She likes to paint pictures of flowers.(她喜欢画花。)
She likes to draw pictures of animals.(她喜欢画动物的画。)
The artist painted a beautiful picture of the mountains.(那位艺术家画了一幅美丽的山景画。)

members.gloss: v.设计; 构思. n.设计; 图案.
members.example: She designed a beautiful poster for the school event.(她为学校活动设计了一张漂亮的海报。)
We decorated the classroom with flowers and balloons.(我们用鲜花和气球装饰了教室。)

analysis.pos_difference: paint：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；draw：v.（动词）；artist：n.（名词）；design：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；decorate：v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: paint 指用颜料画、刷漆；draw 指用线条画（draw-drawn）；artist 指画家、艺术家；design 指设计；decorate 指装饰。
analysis.collocation: paint a picture；draw a picture；design a poster；decorate the room
analysis.summary: 涂颜料用 paint；画线条用 draw；设计用 design；装饰用 decorate。

members.gloss: adj.可移动的; 移动的. n.手机.
members.example: Please turn off your mobile phone in class.(请在课堂上关掉手机。)

members.gloss: n.电话; 电话机. v.打电话.
members.example: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.(亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔于1876年发明了电话。)

members.gloss: v.（铃）响; 打电话. n.戒指; 铃声; 环.
members.example: The phone rang while I was having dinner.(我吃晚饭时电话响了。)
The bell rings at eight o'clock every morning.(每天早上八点钟铃声响起。)

analysis.pos_difference: mobile：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）；telephone：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；ring：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；bell：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: mobile 指手机（mobile phone）；telephone 指电话（机）；ring 指（铃）响、打电话（ring sb. up）；bell 指铃、钟。
analysis.collocation: on the mobile/telephone；ring sb. (up)；The bell rings.
analysis.summary: 手机用 mobile；电话用 telephone；铃响、打电话用 ring；铃用 bell。

members.gloss: n.中间; 中部. adj.中间的; 中等的.
members.example: There is a big tree in the middle of the park.(公园中间有一棵大树。)
There is a shopping center near my home.(我家附近有一个购物中心。)
Don't stand too close to the edge of the swimming pool.(不要站得太靠近游泳池的边缘。)

members.gloss: n.底部; 底端; 尽头.
members.example: The fish swam to the bottom of the lake.(鱼游到了湖底。)

analysis.usage_difference: middle 指中间（in the middle of）；center 指中心；edge 指边缘；bottom 指底部。
analysis.collocation: in the middle of；in the center of；on the edge of；at the bottom of
analysis.summary: 中间用 middle；中心用 center；边缘用 edge；底部用 bottom。

members.example: It's dangerous to swim in this river.(在这条河里游泳很危险。)
The children were in danger when the river flooded.(河水泛滥时孩子们处于危险中。)

members.gloss: adj.安全的；平安的. n.保险箱.
members.example: Is it safe to swim in this river?(在这条河里游泳安全吗？)

analysis.usage_difference: dangerous 是形容词“危险的”；danger 是名词（in danger 处于危险中）；safe 是其反义“安全的”。
analysis.collocation: be dangerous；in danger；out of danger；keep safe
analysis.summary: 危险的用 dangerous；危险（名词）用 danger；安全用 safe。

members.example: Be careful when you cross the road.(过马路时要小心。)
Please listen carefully to the teacher.(请仔细听老师讲课。)
Air pollution is a serious problem in some cities.(空气污染在一些城市是一个严重的问题。)
Our math teacher is very strict with us.(我们的数学老师对我们非常严格。)

analysis.usage_difference: careful 是形容词“小心的”，carefully 是其副词；serious 指认真的、严肃的、严重的；strict 指严格的（be strict with sb.）。
analysis.collocation: be careful (with)；listen carefully；take…seriously；be strict with sb.
analysis.summary: 小心用 careful(-ly)；认真严肃用 serious；对人严格用 strict(with)。

members.gloss: n.春天; 泉水; 弹簧.
members.example: Flowers begin to grow in spring.(花儿在春天开始生长。)
It often snows here in winter.(这里冬天经常下雪。)
The leaves turn red and gold in autumn.(秋天树叶变成红色和金色。)

analysis.usage_difference: spring 春天、winter 冬天、autumn 秋天（英式）；fall 作名词在美式英语中指秋天（作动词指落下，见“位置变化”组）。
analysis.collocation: in spring/winter/autumn
analysis.summary: 秋天英式 autumn、美式 fall；季节前介词用 in。

members.example: The Earth goes around the Sun once a year.(地球每年绕太阳转一圈。)
The ball fell to the ground.(球掉到了地上。)
There is not enough space in my room for another desk.(我房间没有足够的空间再放一张桌子。)

analysis.usage_difference: earth 指地球、泥土；ground 指地面、场地；space 指太空、空间。
analysis.collocation: on earth；on the ground；in space
analysis.summary: 地球用 the earth；地面用 ground；太空用 space。

members.gloss: v.控制；管理. n.控制；支配.
members.example: You should learn to control your temper.(你应该学会控制自己的脾气。)
She managed to finish the project on time.(她设法按时完成了项目。)
The manager of the hotel is very friendly.(酒店经理非常友好。)
Do you know how to operate this machine?(你知道如何操作这台机器吗？)
The doctor said the operation was very successful.(医生说手术非常成功。)

analysis.pos_difference: control：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；manage：v.（动词）；manager：n.（名词）；operate：v.（动词）；operation：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: control 指控制；manage 指管理、设法做到（manage to do）；manager 指经理；operate 指操作、运转、动手术；operation 指手术、操作、运转。
analysis.collocation: under control；manage to do；operate a machine；have an operation
analysis.summary: 控制用 control；管理设法用 manage(to do)；操作用 operate；手术用 operation。

members.gloss: adj.直的; 坦率的. adv.直接地; 笔直地.
members.example: Go straight ahead and you will see the library on your left.(一直往前走，你会看到图书馆在你左边。)

members.gloss: adj.直接的；径直的. v.指挥；导演.
members.example: Is there a direct flight from Beijing to London?(有从北京到伦敦的直飞航班吗？)
The director of the movie won many awards.(这部电影的导演获得了许多奖项。)

analysis.pos_difference: straight：adj.（形容词）、adv.（副词）；direct：adj.（形容词）、v.（动词）；director：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: straight 指笔直的（go straight）；direct 指直接的，作动词指指挥、导演；director 指导演、主管。
analysis.collocation: go straight；a direct flight；a film director
analysis.summary: 笔直用 straight；直接用 direct；导演主管用 director。

members.example: Please follow me to the meeting room.(请跟我到会议室。)
According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.(根据天气预报，明天会下雨。)

analysis.usage_difference: follow 指跟随、遵循（规则、建议）；according 不单独用，according to 表示根据、按照。
analysis.collocation: follow the rules/advice；according to the report
analysis.summary: 跟随遵循用 follow；“按照…”用 according to。

members.example: Don't rush — we still have plenty of time.(别急——我们还有很多时间。)

members.gloss: v.赶紧; 匆忙. n.急忙.
members.example: Hurry up, or we'll be late for school!(快点，否则我们上学要迟到了！)

members.gloss: adj.慢的; 迟缓的. v.放慢.
members.example: The traffic was very slow this morning.(今天早上交通很慢。)

analysis.pos_difference: rush：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；hurry：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；slow：adj.（形容词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: rush 指冲、匆忙（rush to do）；hurry 指赶紧（hurry up，in a hurry）；slow 指慢的（反义），作动词指放慢。
analysis.collocation: rush out；hurry up；in a hurry；slow down
analysis.summary: 冲忙用 rush；催促用 hurry(up)；放慢用 slow(down)。

members.example: The teacher advised us to read more books.(老师建议我们多读书。)
I suggest that we go to the park this afternoon.(我建议今天下午我们去公园。)
Thank you for your suggestion. I'll think about it.(谢谢你的建议，我会考虑的。)

analysis.usage_difference: advise 指劝告（advise sb. to do / advise doing）；suggest 指建议（suggest doing / suggest that…，不接 sb. to do）；suggestion 是可数名词（注意：advice 不可数）。
analysis.collocation: advise sb. to do；suggest doing；make a suggestion
analysis.summary: 劝某人做用 advise sb. to do；建议做用 suggest doing；名词建议用 suggestion。

members.gloss: adj.最后的; 上一个的. adv.最后. v.持续.
members.example: The sports meeting lasted for three days.(运动会持续了三天。)

members.gloss: adj.最后的; 最终的. n.决赛.
members.example: The final exam is next week.(期末考试在下周。)

analysis.pos_difference: last：adj.（形容词）、adv.（副词）、v.（动词）；final：adj.（形容词）、n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: last 指最后的、上一个的（last week），作动词指持续；final 指最终的、决定性的（the final exam 期终考试）。
analysis.collocation: last week/year；at last；the final exam；in the final
analysis.summary: 上一个、最后用 last；最终的（结果、考试）用 final。

members.example: The price includes breakfast.(价格包含早餐。)
Everyone passed the test except Tom.(除了汤姆，每个人都通过了考试。)

analysis.usage_difference: include 指包括、包含；except 指除……之外（不包括）。
analysis.collocation: including…；everyone except me
analysis.summary: 包括用 include；除外用 except。

members.example: The teacher warned us not to be late again.(老师警告我们不要再迟到了。)
Please inform your parents about the school meeting.(请通知你的父母关于学校会议的事。)

members.gloss: v.注意到；留意. n.通知；公告.
members.example: Did you notice the new painting on the wall?(你注意到墙上那幅新画了吗？)

members.gloss: n.笔记; 便条; 注释. v.注意; 记录.
members.example: Please take notes during the lesson.(请在上课时做笔记。)

analysis.pos_difference: warn：v.（动词）；inform：v.（动词）；notice：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；note：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: warn 指警告（warn sb. of/against/not to do）；inform 指（正式）通知（inform sb. of）；notice 指注意到、布告；note 指笔记、便条。
analysis.collocation: warn sb. of danger；inform sb. of sth.；notice sb. doing；take notes
analysis.summary: 警告用 warn；正式告知用 inform；注意到、布告用 notice；笔记用 note。

members.gloss: adj.基本的; 基础的. n.基础.
members.example: You need to learn the basic rules of grammar first.(你需要先学习基本的语法规则。)
The movie is based on a true story.(这部电影是根据真实故事改编的。)

analysis.usage_difference: basic 指基本的、基础的；base 指底部、基地，作动词指以…为基础（be based on）。
analysis.collocation: basic skills/knowledge；at the base of；be based on
analysis.summary: 基本的用 basic；以…为基础用 base(be based on)。

members.example: The baby's skin is very soft.(婴儿的皮肤非常柔软。)
The surface of the table is very smooth.(桌子的表面非常光滑。)
The surface of the rock felt very rough.(这块岩石的表面摸起来很粗糙。)

analysis.usage_difference: soft 指柔软的、轻柔的；smooth 指光滑的、平稳的；rough 指粗糙的、粗暴的（反义对照）。
analysis.collocation: soft music/skin；a smooth road；rough hands
analysis.summary: 柔软用 soft；光滑用 smooth；粗糙用 rough。

members.example: The government has a new policy on education.(政府出台了新的教育政策。)

members.gloss: adj.官方的；正式的. n.官员.
members.example: English is the official language of many countries.(英语是许多国家的官方语言。)
The secretary answered the phone and took a message.(秘书接了电话并记下了留言。)

analysis.usage_difference: policy 指政策、方针；official 指官方的（作名词指官员）；secretary 指秘书、书记。
analysis.collocation: government policy；an official visit；a general secretary
analysis.summary: 政策用 policy；官方的/官员用 official；秘书用 secretary。

members.gloss: n.方向; 指导; 说明.
members.example: Can you tell me the direction to the train station?(你能告诉我去火车站的方向吗？)

members.gloss: n.地址; 演讲. v.写地址; 演说.
members.example: Please write your address on this form.(请在这张表格上写下你的地址。)

analysis.usage_difference: direction 指方向（in the direction of），复数可指用法说明；address 指地址，也可指演讲。
analysis.collocation: in all directions；ask the way/direction；home address
analysis.summary: 方向用 direction；地址用 address。

members.example: Gold and silver are precious metals.(金和银是贵重金属。)
The gate is made of iron and looks very strong.(大门是铁做的，看起来很坚固。)
This bridge is made of steel and concrete.(这座桥是用钢铁和混凝土建造的。)
We should use fewer plastic bags to protect the environment.(我们应该少用塑料袋来保护环境。)

analysis.pos_difference: metal：n.（名词）；iron：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；steel：n.（名词）；plastic：n.（名词）、adj.（形容词）。
analysis.usage_difference: metal 指金属（总称）；iron 指铁（也可指熨斗）；steel 指钢；plastic 指塑料。
analysis.collocation: made of metal/iron/steel/plastic
analysis.summary: 金属总称 metal；铁 iron；钢 steel；塑料 plastic。

members.example: What is the date today?(今天是几号？)
I marked the date of the trip on the calendar.(我在日历上标注了旅行的日期。)

analysis.usage_difference: date 指日期（What's the date today?），也可指约会；calendar 指日历。
analysis.collocation: the date of birth；look at the calendar
analysis.summary: 日期用 date；日历用 calendar。

members.example: Students are under a lot of pressure before exams.(学生们在考试前压力很大。)

members.gloss: n.压力; 紧张; 重音. v.强调.
members.example: Too much stress is bad for your health.(太多压力对你的健康不好。)

analysis.usage_difference: pressure 指（外界施加的）压力（under pressure）；stress 指（内心的）压力、紧张，也可指重音、强调。
analysis.collocation: under pressure；reduce stress；lay stress on
analysis.summary: 外界压力用 pressure；心理紧张用 stress。

members.example: The result of the game disappointed all the fans.(比赛结果令所有球迷失望。)

members.gloss: adj.心烦的; 不安的. v.使心烦; 打翻.
members.example: She was upset because she lost her favorite book.(她很难过，因为她丢了她最喜欢的书。)

analysis.usage_difference: disappoint 指使失望（disappointed 感到失望的）；upset 指心烦的、难过的，作动词指使心烦、打翻。
analysis.collocation: be disappointed with/at；feel upset
analysis.summary: 失望用 disappoint(-ed)；心烦难过用 upset。

members.example: My mother was angry because I came home late.(妈妈很生气，因为我回家晚了。)

members.gloss: adj.疯狂的; 生气的; 狂热的.
members.example: Are you mad at me?(你在生我的气吗？)

analysis.usage_difference: angry 指生气的（be angry with sb.）；mad 口语中指生气的、疯狂的。
analysis.collocation: be angry with sb./about sth.；be mad at；go mad
analysis.summary: 生气用 angry(with)；口语用 mad(at)。

members.example: The old man is deaf and cannot hear anything.(这位老人耳聋了，什么也听不到。)
We should help disabled people in our daily life.(我们应该在日常生活中帮助残疾人。)

analysis.usage_difference: deaf 指聋的（the deaf 聋人）；disable 是动词“使残疾、使失去能力”（disabled 残疾的）。
analysis.collocation: be deaf in one ear；disabled people
analysis.summary: 聋的用 deaf；使残疾用 disable（形容词 disabled）。

members.example: This is a private matter and I don't want to talk about it.(这是私事，我不想谈论。)

members.gloss: n.秘密. adj.秘密的; 保密的.
members.example: Can you keep a secret for me?(你能替我保守秘密吗？)

analysis.usage_difference: private 指私人的、私密的（private life/school）；secret 指秘密（keep a secret）。
analysis.collocation: in private；private information；keep a secret；in secret
analysis.summary: 私人的用 private；秘密用 secret。

members.example: They moved into a new apartment near the school.(他们搬进了学校附近的一套新公寓。)
The road is flat and easy to ride a bicycle on.(这条路很平坦，适合骑自行车。)

analysis.usage_difference: apartment 指公寓（美式）；flat 指公寓（英式），也常作形容词“平坦的”。
analysis.collocation: live in an apartment/flat
analysis.summary: 公寓美式 apartment、英式 flat。

members.example: How much do you weigh now?(你现在体重多少？)

members.gloss: v.测量；衡量. n.措施；尺寸.
members.example: We need to measure the length of this table.(我们需要测量这张桌子的长度。)
What is your height?(你身高多少？)

members.gloss: adj.宽阔的; 广泛的. adv.广阔地.
members.example: The river is too wide to swim across.(这条河太宽了，游不过去。)
My home is about three kilometers from the school.(我家离学校大约三公里。)
The distance from my home to school is about two kilometers.(从我家到学校的距离大约两公里。)

analysis.pos_difference: weigh：v.（动词）；measure：v.（动词）、n.（名词）；height：n.（名词）；wide：adj.（形容词）、adv.（副词）；kilometer：n.（名词）；distance：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: weigh 指称重、重达；measure 指测量；height 指高度、身高；wide 指宽阔的；kilometer 指公里；distance 指距离。
analysis.collocation: weigh 50 kilos；measure the room；in height；two meters wide；within walking distance
analysis.summary: 称重用 weigh；测量用 measure；高度 height、宽度 wide；距离用 distance。

members.example: This machine can make a hundred toys a day.(这台机器一天能生产一百个玩具。)
A dictionary is a useful tool for learning a language.(字典是学习语言的有用工具。)
Most students have a digital watch these days.(现在大多数学生都有一块电子手表。)
My father bought an electric bike to ride to work.(我爸爸买了一辆电动自行车去上班。)
The battery of my phone is running low.(我手机的电池快没电了。)

analysis.pos_difference: machine：n.（名词）；tool：n.（名词）；digital：adj.（形容词）；electric：adj.（形容词）；battery：n.（名词）。
analysis.usage_difference: machine 指机器；tool 指（手工）工具；digital 指数字的；electric 指电的、电动的；battery 指电池。
analysis.collocation: a washing machine；garden tools；a digital camera；an electric car；change the battery
analysis.summary: 机器用 machine；工具用 tool；数码的用 digital；电动的用 electric；电池用 battery。

members.example: The brave fireman saved the little girl from the fire.(勇敢的消防员从火中救出了小女孩。)
It takes courage to stand up and speak in front of everyone.(站起来在大家面前讲话需要勇气。)
He didn't dare to speak in front of so many people.(他不敢在那么多人面前讲话。)

analysis.usage_difference: brave 是形容词“勇敢的”；courage 是名词“勇气”；dare 指敢（dare (to) do）。
analysis.collocation: a brave soldier；have the courage to do；dare (to) do
analysis.summary: 勇敢用 brave；勇气用 courage；“敢”用 dare。

members.gloss: n.女性；雌性. adj.女性的；雌的.
members.example: There are more female students than male students in our class.(我们班女生比男生多。)
My daughter is ten years old this year.(我女儿今年十岁了。)

analysis.usage_difference: female 指女性的、雌性的（作名词指女性）；daughter 指女儿。
analysis.collocation: a female teacher；his daughter
analysis.summary: 女性（性别）用 female；女儿用 daughter。

members.example: The students sat in a circle and played games.(学生们围成一圈做游戏。)

members.gloss: adj.圆的; 圆形的. prep.围绕. adv.周围. v.绕行.
members.example: The earth is round like a ball.(地球像球一样是圆的。)

members.gloss: adv.在周围; 大约. prep.围绕.
members.example: There are many trees around the lake.(湖的周围有很多树。)

analysis.pos_difference: circle：n.（名词）；round：adj.（形容词）、prep.（介词）、adv.（副词）、v.（动词）；around：adv.（副词）、prep.（介词）。
analysis.usage_difference: circle 指圆圈（作动词指环绕）；round 指圆的，作介词/副词指围绕；ring（见“电话”组）也可指圆环、戒指；around 指在周围、大约。
analysis.collocation: draw a circle；a round table；sit around；around the corner
analysis.summary: 圆圈用 circle；圆的/围绕用 round；指环用 ring；在周围用 around。

members.example: He tied the boat to the tree with a rope.(他用绳子把船系在树上。)

members.gloss: n.链条；一连串. v.用链拴住.
members.example: She wore a silver chain around her neck.(她脖子上戴着一条银链。)

analysis.usage_difference: rope 指绳子；chain 指链条（也可指连锁店）。
analysis.collocation: jump rope；a gold chain；a chain of shops
analysis.summary: 绳子用 rope；链条用 chain。

members.example: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.(请用正确的单词填空。)

members.gloss: adj.空的; 空洞的. v.倒空.
members.example: The bottle is empty — there is no water left.(瓶子空了——没有水了。)
She poured a glass of water for her grandmother.(她给奶奶倒了一杯水。)

analysis.usage_difference: blank 指空白的（纸、表格）；empty 指空的（容器、房间），作动词指倒空；pour 指倒（液体）、倾泻。
analysis.collocation: fill in the blank；an empty bottle；pour tea
analysis.summary: 空白用 blank；空容器用 empty；倒水用 pour。

members.example: Do you have any other questions?(你还有其他问题吗？)
Would you like another cup of tea?(你想再来一杯茶吗？)

analysis.usage_difference: other 指其他的（the other 两者中的另一个，others 别人）；another 指三者以上中的另一个。
analysis.collocation: the other day；each other；one another；another cup of tea
analysis.summary: 其他的用 other；再来一个用 another。

members.example: We took a plane to Beijing last summer.(去年夏天我们乘飞机去了北京。)
We traveled to Beijing by airplane.(我们乘飞机去了北京。)
We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.(我们在航班起飞前两小时到达了机场。)
He wants to be a pilot and fly around the world.(他想成为一名飞行员，飞遍全世界。)

members.gloss: n.飞行; 航班; 楼梯的一段.
members.example: Our flight to Shanghai leaves at 8 a.m.(我们去上海的航班早上8点起飞。)

analysis.usage_difference: plane 是 airplane 的口语缩略，都指飞机；airport 指机场；pilot 指飞行员；flight 指航班、飞行。
analysis.collocation: by plane；take a plane；at the airport；Flight CA938
analysis.summary: 飞机用 plane(=airplane)；机场用 airport；飞行员用 pilot；航班用 flight。

members.example: The traffic is very heavy during rush hour.(高峰时段交通非常拥挤。)
A big truck was carrying goods to the supermarket.(一辆大卡车正在往超市运送货物。)
China has built many high-speed railways in recent years.(中国近年来修建了许多高速铁路。)

members.gloss: n.运输；交通工具. v.运送.
members.example: What is the best means of transport in your city?(在你的城市里最好的交通方式是什么？)

members.gloss: n.循环；周期；自行车. v.骑自行车.
members.example: The four seasons form a natural cycle every year.(四季每年形成一个自然循环。)

analysis.pos_difference: traffic：n.（名词）；truck：n.（名词）；railway：n.（名词）；transport：n.（名词）、v.（动词）；cycle：n.（名词）、v.（动词）。
analysis.usage_difference: traffic 指交通（流量，不可数）；truck 指卡车；railway 指铁路；transport 指运输、交通工具；cycle 作名词指自行车，作动词指骑自行车，也可指循环。
analysis.collocation: heavy traffic；traffic lights；by railway；public transport；cycle to school
analysis.summary: 交通流量用 traffic；卡车用 truck；铁路用 railway；运输用 transport；骑自行车用 cycle。

members.gloss: v.加入; 参加; 连接.
members.example: Would you like to join our English club?(你想加入我们的英语俱乐部吗？)

members.gloss: v.出席; 参加; 照料.
members.example: All students must attend the school meeting.(所有学生必须参加学校会议。)

members.gloss: n.会议; 集会; 会面.
members.example: We will have a class meeting this afternoon.(今天下午我们要开班会。)
Tom was absent from school because he was ill.(汤姆因病没来上学。)

analysis.usage_difference: join 指加入（团体、人群，join sb./the club）；attend 指出席、参加（会议、课程，较正式）；meeting 指会议（attend/hold a meeting）；absent 指缺席的（be absent from，反义对照）。
analysis.collocation: join the army/club；join in；attend a meeting/school；be absent from school
analysis.summary: 加入团体用 join；出席会议上课用 attend；缺席用 absent(from)。

members.gloss: v.鼓励; 激励; 支持.
members.example: My teacher always encourages me to try new things.(我的老师总是鼓励我尝试新事物。)

members.gloss: v.支持; 支撑. n.支持; 赡养.
members.example: My parents always support me in whatever I do.(无论我做什么，父母总是支持我。)

members.gloss: v.提供; 供给; 供应.
members.example: The school provides free lunch for students.(学校为学生提供免费午餐。)

analysis.usage_difference: encourage 指鼓励（encourage sb. to do）；support 指支持、支撑；provide 指提供（provide sth. for sb. / provide sb. with sth.）。
analysis.collocation: encourage sb. to do；support one's family；provide sth. for sb. / provide sb. with sth.
analysis.summary: 鼓励用 encourage；支持用 support；提供用 provide。

members.example: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.(这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。)

members.gloss: adj.感到无聊的; 厌烦的.
members.example: I felt bored because there was nothing to do at home.(我觉得无聊，因为在家没什么事可做。)

analysis.usage_difference: boring 指（事物）令人无聊的；bored 指（人）感到无聊的。
analysis.collocation: a boring film；be/feel bored
analysis.summary: 物令人无聊用 boring；人感到无聊用 bored。

members.gloss: n.情况; 形势; 处境.
members.example: We must find a way to improve the situation.(我们必须想办法改善这种情况。)

members.gloss: n.条件; 状况; 情况.
members.example: The old house is in poor condition.(那座老房子状况很差。)
Can you show me the position of our school on the map?(你能在地图上指出我们学校的位置吗？)
The location of the new library is near the park.(新图书馆的位置在公园附近。)

members.gloss: n.场景; 情景; 景色.
members.example: The opening scene of the movie was very exciting.(电影的开场场景非常精彩。)

analysis.usage_difference: situation 指形势、处境；condition 指条件、状况；position 指位置、职位、立场；location 指（地理）位置、地点；scene 指场景、现场、景色。
analysis.collocation: in a difficult situation；living conditions；in position；the location of；the scene of the accident
analysis.summary: 处境用 situation；条件状况用 condition；职位位置用 position；地点用 location；现场场景用 scene。

members.example: What is the best method of learning English?(学习英语最好的方法是什么？)

members.gloss: n.系统; 制度; 体系.
members.example: The school has a new computer system.(学校有了新的计算机系统。)
I like the flower pattern on this dress.(我喜欢这条裙子上的花朵图案。)

members.gloss: n.风格; 式样; 款式.
members.example: I like the style of this dress.(我喜欢这条裙子的款式。)

analysis.usage_difference: method 指方法（有条理的）；system 指系统、制度；pattern 指模式、图案；style 指风格、款式。
analysis.collocation: a teaching method；the method of；a system of；behavior patterns；in style；life style
analysis.summary: 方法用 method；系统制度用 system；模式图案用 pattern；风格款式用 style。

members.example: Who organized this school trip?(谁组织了这次学校旅行？)
She joined an organization that helps protect the environment.(她加入了一个帮助保护环境的组织。)

analysis.usage_difference: organize 是动词，指组织、安排；organization 是名词，指组织、机构。
analysis.collocation: organize an activity；an international organization
analysis.summary: 动词组织用 organize；名词机构用 organization。

members.gloss: n.尊敬; 尊重. v.尊敬; 尊重.
members.example: We should respect our teachers and parents.(我们应该尊敬老师和父母。)
I really admire her courage to speak in front of so many people.(我很钦佩她在那么多人面前发言的勇气。)

analysis.usage_difference: respect 指尊敬、尊重（人、规则）；admire 指钦佩、羡慕（才华、成就）。
analysis.collocation: respect one's teachers；admire sb. for sth.
analysis.summary: 尊敬用 respect；钦佩羡慕用 admire。

members.example: The book is mainly about Chinese history.(这本书主要是关于中国历史的。)

members.gloss: adj.主要的; 重大的. n.主修课程.
members.example: Pollution is a major problem in many cities.(污染是许多城市的一个主要问题。)

analysis.usage_difference: mainly 是副词“主要地”；major 是形容词“主要的、重大的”（major in 主修）。
analysis.collocation: mainly because；a major problem；major in English
analysis.summary: 副词主要用 mainly；形容词主要的用 major。

members.example: The sky turned gray before the rain started.(下雨前天空变成了灰色。)
She looked pale after being sick for a week.(她病了一个星期后看起来很苍白。)

analysis.usage_difference: gray 指灰色的（英式拼写 grey）；pale 指苍白的（脸色）。
analysis.collocation: gray hair；turn pale
analysis.summary: 灰色用 gray；苍白用 pale。
